A '''shakudo dolabra''' is the [[Shakudo equipment|shakudo]] [[dolabra]], made by smithing a [[Copper Axe|copper axe]] with [[Shakudo Alloy|shakudo alloy]]. It mines at speed 7 and has 1000 durability.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/smithing/shakudo_dolabra.json}}</ref>

As a [[dolabra]], it works as both a pickaxe and an axe, at a lower mining speed than the shakudo pickaxe or axe.

== Obtaining ==

=== Smithing ===
{{Recipes}}

This upgrade needs a [[Smithing Upgrade Template|smithing upgrade template]] in the template slot. The recipe matches the base by item ID, so a [[Copper Dolabra|copper dolabra]] works as the base as well as a copper axe. Without the template, the same base and alloy make a [[Shakudo Axe|shakudo axe]] instead.

Enchantments already on the base item are kept. Where the base and the new item share an enchantment, the higher level is used.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/intrinsic_enchants/process_intrinsic_enchants.mcfunction}}</ref>

=== Loot ===
{{Sources}}

The loot table <code>matcha:equipment/shakudo/dolabra</code> gives the item exactly as crafted; it is used by <code>/loot</code> and by the [[Updating items|item update system]].

== Usage ==

=== Mining ===

It mines both pickaxe and axe blocks at speed 7.

Its tool rules have no obsidian restriction, so it mines obsidian with drops at its normal speed, although the [[Matcha Flavoured 1.12.1-alpha|1.12.1-alpha]] notes say only diamond, electrum and adamant tools can mine obsidian.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/smithing/shakudo_dolabra.json}}</ref>

The pack adds beds, candles, cactus and honeycomb blocks to the blocks axes mine quickly.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/tags/block/mineable/axe.json}}</ref>

=== Combat ===

It deals 7 damage with an attack speed of 1.

=== Intrinsics ===

* [[Silk Touch]] I

The intrinsics are stored on the item and applied when it enters an inventory. See [[Shakudo equipment]] for how the tier's intrinsics work together.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/intrinsic_enchants/apply_intrinsic_enchants.mcfunction}}</ref>

=== Repairing ===

It is repaired in an [[anvil]] with {{MCW|Block of Copper|blocks of copper}}. Matcha Flavoured removes the repair cost limit, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].

=== Trading ===
An apprentice-level [[Weaponsmith|weaponsmith]] takes it in exchange for one [[Shakudo Alloy|shakudo alloy]], so the alloy can be reused.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/weaponsmith/2/shakudo_dolabra.json}}</ref>

== Notes ==
* Its attack modifiers have no slot set, so they also apply while the dolabra is held in the off hand.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/smithing/shakudo_dolabra.json}}</ref>

== History ==
{{History|
{{History line|0.4-alpha|Added translation support for all armor and tools. Shakudo armor could not be crafted; this was fixed.}}
{{History line|1.10|Alloy equipment can be traded to a [[Weaponsmith|weaponsmith]] for its alloy, so players can rebuild old items with updated stats. Shakudo was renamed from "Palatinate" in the language file only, so existing items keep working. Shakudo alloy became more expensive: 3 gold and 6 copper ingots became 2 blocks of gold and 4 blocks of copper.}}
{{History line|1.12.1-alpha|Smithing no longer needs a base-metal ingot in the template slot; the slot is left empty. Smithing now keeps the enchantments already on the item. Added the "Repaired with" tooltip, and repair materials were made consistent across all alloys. Shakudo intrinsics are now exclusive with the electrum and adamant intrinsics.}}
{{History line|1.12.2|Moved to the <code>matcha</code> namespace; older items can be updated with <code>/trigger update_item</code>. Dolabras were redefined as axe (tool) and pickaxe hybrids rather than weapons: damage goes down and weapon intrinsics are removed over time.}}
}}
